description: Find Cyprus companies and partnerships registered with the Registrar of Companies, by registration number (e.g. "HE 123456", "ΗΕ 123456", "S 1817") or by the start of the registered name (e.g. "BANK OF CYPRUS"). Returns name, number, status, registration date and the company page link. Includes struck-off and dissolved companies.

query.description: Registration number, or the beginning of the company name (Latin or Greek).

name: search_companies
title: Search Cyprus companies
